case.request: Ava's insurer denied her MRI claim. Build an evidence-backed internal appeal packet. The appeal is due by 30 November 2026.

steps: Retrieve all denial reasons for claim CLM-2026-0915 to understand the specific grounds for denial.
Fetch policy clauses referenced in the denial and those relevant to MRI medical necessity, conservative treatment, and documentation requirements.
Gather Ava's medical records within the 365-day lookback period (from 2025-10-24 to 2026-10-24) to support clinical history.
Obtain the Explanation of Benefits (EOB) for the claim to see payment details and denial codes.
Get procedure code details for MRI-LS-001 to verify coding accuracy and medical necessity criteria.
Collect all claim documents submitted for CLM-2026-0915 to identify missing documents (especially DOC-003).
Retrieve ICD-10 code details for M54.5 and radiculopathy codes (M54.1-M54.4) to assess diagnosis specificity.
Check for any existing appeal evidence already submitted for this claim.
Get claim-level facts for CLM-2026-0915 to understand claim status and metadata.

cover_letter: I am requesting an internal appeal of Northbridge Health's denial dated 2026-10-01 for claim CLM-2026-0915. The denial gives 4 reasons; 3 are contradicted by the policy, the clinical record or the coding. The remaining reason concerns a missing required document: Specialist referral letter (DOC-003). It is listed in the checklist and will be supplied; it has not been fabricated. The evidence for each reason is indexed below.

rebuttals.text: The denial cites POL-4.3, the experimental exclusion. That clause applies to SPINE-FUSION-001 and states it does not apply to diagnostic MRI of the lumbar spine. POL-4.1 covers MRI-LS-001 after at least six weeks of conservative therapy.

The denial cites MRI-LS-002 and diagnosis M51.1. The order, the EOB and the record use MRI-LS-001 and diagnosis M54.5. MRI-LS-001 is described as 'MRI lumbar spine without contrast' and does not require prior authorisation; MRI-LS-002 is the contrast study that does.
The record documents 12 physiotherapy sessions over 12 weeks and an NSAID trial. POL-5.1 requires at least six weeks of conservative therapy.
This required document is genuinely missing from the file. It is listed in the checklist and will be supplied. It has not been fabricated.

limitations: This packet assembles evidence for human review. It is not medical or legal advice.
It does not predict the insurer's decision; a human must review and sign it.
No missing document has been fabricated.

attacks.claim: The appeal is missing required document DOC-003, which is a mandatory component for conditional approval per policy Section 7.3.
attacks.evidence: Claim record shows missing_documents: ["DOC-003"] and status: "conditional" with DEN-04 still open.

attacks.claim: Procedure code MRI-LS-001 does not match the diagnosed condition M54.5 (low back pain, unspecified) under medical necessity guidelines.
attacks.evidence: Policy requires specific radiculopathy or neurological deficit codes (M54.1-M54.4) for lumbar MRI without contrast; M54.5 alone is insufficient.

attacks.claim: The 12 physiotherapy sessions over 12 weeks fail to meet the conservative treatment prerequisite of 6 weeks minimum with documented failure.
attacks.evidence: Records indicate therapy duration but lack documented clinical reassessment at week 6 showing no improvement, required by policy Section 4.2.

attacks.claim: Diagnosis verification flag is false, indicating the diagnosis M54.5 lacks supporting imaging correlation or specialist referral documentation.
attacks.evidence: No radiology report or neurologist/orthopedist referral in file to substantiate M54.5 as primary indication for advanced imaging.
